assessment.nobel_worthiness: The experimental discovery of the Higgs boson completed a central part of the Standard Model and stands among the most consequential results in particle physics.
assessment.attribution: Recognizing the leaders who conceived and built ATLAS and CMS acknowledges essential experimental work, though the discovery depended on exceptionally large international collaborations.
assessment.maturity: The signal has been confirmed and studied extensively since 2012; its interpretation and place in particle physics are well established.
uncertainties: How to recognize individual leadership fairly when the discovery relied on two very large collaborations.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks have transformed precision measurement, enabling new tests of fundamental physics and sensitive measurements of gravitational potential.
assessment.attribution: Katori and Ye made distinct, complementary advances in clock concepts and experimental realization; the named credit is persuasive.
assessment.maturity: Clocks have reached extraordinary precision and independent groups have reproduced and extended the results.
uncertainties: The long-term balance between fundamental discoveries enabled by these clocks and their still-developing applications.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The quantum cascade laser created a new class of semiconductor laser with distinctive wavelength control and broad uses in spectroscopy and sensing.
assessment.attribution: Capasso and Faist are central to the device concept and its first realization; Alfred Cho's role in the semiconductor growth platform merits consideration in defining the precise scope of the prize.
assessment.maturity: The laser has been developed and used widely over several decades.
uncertainties: How to apportion credit among the device inventors and those whose semiconductor growth advances made it practical.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Realizing strongly interacting Fermi gases and the BEC-BCS crossover opened a powerful experimental route to fermionic superfluidity and strongly correlated quantum matter.
assessment.attribution: Thomas and Grimm led major experimental programs that established key regimes; Christophe Salomon also made important contributions to this field.
assessment.maturity: The crossover and related phenomena have been studied extensively across independent laboratories.
uncertainties: The discovery spans several experiments and groups, making a three-person attribution difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Circuit quantum electrodynamics established a highly controllable platform for studying light-matter interaction and building superconducting quantum devices.
assessment.attribution: Blais's theory and the experimental work of Wallraff and Schoelkopf form a strong core attribution; Girvin's foundational contributions should also be weighed.
assessment.maturity: The platform has been reproduced, extended, and used in increasingly complex quantum experiments.
uncertainties: The boundary between the original cQED contribution and the wider development of superconducting qubits is not sharp.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Trapped-ion experiments and their theoretical foundations made quantum computation and simulation experimentally concrete, with unusually precise control of individual quantum systems.
assessment.attribution: Cirac and Zoller supplied key proposals, while Blatt's group demonstrated central operations; the trio captures the theory-experiment arc.
assessment.maturity: The platform has achieved sustained experimental progress and independent replication, though scalable fault-tolerant operation remains a major challenge.
uncertainties: Whether the prize should recognize foundational demonstrations now or await a more definitive computational milestone.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ultracold atoms in optical lattices provide a versatile and exceptionally clean way to probe many-body physics and simulate models of correlated matter.
assessment.attribution: Bloch, Greiner, and Esslinger led landmark experiments, while Cirac and Zoller supplied important theoretical foundations; the broad credit requires careful scoping.
assessment.maturity: The experimental methods are well established, but the most consequential advances in understanding real strongly correlated materials remain in progress.
uncertainties: Whether quantum simulation has yet delivered a sufficiently decisive result beyond the platform and its demonstrations.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Photonic crystals and band gaps established a powerful way to control light propagation and emission, with lasting influence on optics and photonics.
assessment.attribution: Yablonovitch and John independently introduced central ideas, and Joannopoulos helped develop the theoretical and practical framework.
assessment.maturity: The physics is well established and has inspired a large body of work, although the most ambitious applications have had uneven impact.
uncertainties: The breadth of the field makes it difficult to identify one sharply bounded discovery and its principal contributors.
